t.zh: 扫描器将接收彩色图，不能直接把三个颜色读数当作一个标量强度。把已经学会的加权关系用到通道轴，构建可调整的单通道测量。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
t.en: The scanner will receive colour images. Three colour readings are not one scalar measurement. Reuse weighted combination along the channel axis to build an adjustable single-channel measurement. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

after.zh: 空间与通道是不同聚合维度。这里的颜色权重是仪器规范，不是任意编码下的物理亮度。 <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>
after.en: Space and channels are different aggregation dimensions. These colour weights specify an instrument, not universal physical luminance. <wiki-ref to="channel-aggregation"></wiki-ref>

brief.zh: 输入为 RGB 读数。按给定通道贡献输出单通道测量；保留空间位置，权重已给定且无需手算。
brief.en: The input contains RGB readings. Combine the supplied channel contributions into one-channel measurements, preserving positions; weights and arithmetic are supplied.

naiveWhy.zh: 空间位置不变不代表三个通道相同。只取 R 会漏掉其他通道的证据。
naiveWhy.en: Matching positions do not make channels identical. Reading only R loses the other channels.

hint.zh: 纯红、纯绿、纯蓝测试会分别显示每个通道是否接入。
hint.en: Pure red, green and blue samples expose each channel’s contribution.

desc.zh: 按输入 wr、wg、wb 汇合 RGB，运行你自己的跨通道加权电路。
desc.en: Combine RGB with wr,wg,wb using your passed channel-weighting circuit.
